_README: An operator's record that a long-quiet feed was checked by hand and the
silence is expected. Read by check_deployment.py when a feed passes
This is not a mute button. It expires on quiet_until, it lives in git so
it carries an author and a date, and it covers only 'they have been quiet
a long time'. A feed nobody is asking, a feed returning errors, a failed
run and an unreachable service are all still reported.
Set quiet_until to when you next want to be asked, not to when you expect
the source to come back. Delete an entry once the feed is publishing again.

data_freshness.note: ASDMA stopped publishing daily flood reports after 2026-10-31, which is normal outside the monsoon. Checked by hand: the portal is up and the URL has not moved -- landslide reports for 1, 8, 12, 13 and 14 November all return correctly dated PDFs from the same base, and 2026-10-25 still serves a flood PDF, so the flood path itself works. Re-check in December; flood reports are not expected back before the 2027 monsoon.
